method.method_draft: First read the pie chart labels: Alicia has 45%, Colby has 25%, and Brenda has 30%. Combine the non-Brenda shares from the image: Alicia plus Colby is 45% + 25% = 70%, while Brenda is 30%. Read from the text that Brenda's 30% corresponds to 36 votes. Use the ratio of non-Brenda votes to Brenda votes, 70:30 = 7:3, to find non-Brenda votes: 36 × 7/3 = 84. Then add Brenda's votes: 84 + 36 = 120 total votes.
